summary.text: Mike Pushkin is a Democratic member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 54, where he has served since 2015, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is also the chair of the Democratic Party of West Virginia.

paragraphs.text: Mike Pushkin was born in Charleston, West Virginia, and graduated from George Washington High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in English and political science from West Virginia University.
His career experience includes working as a taxi driver and musician.
Pushkin has served in the House of Delegates since 2015 and, according to Ballotpedia, is also the Democratic Party of West Virginia Chair.
